QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_38

question.text: Which of the following is the LEAST preferred (worst-case) exit option from an investee company?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes corporate liquidation as the least preferred, worst-case exit option — it is a statutory process that typically delivers only salvage value and usually implies investee bankruptcy. The Trap: IPO offer for sale is described as the most preferred exit. Trade sale and M&A / strategic sale sit in the middle of the ranking. Corporate liquidation is worst. Note: The exit-option ranking, with corporate liquidation as the worst case, is set out in the workbook on p. 356.
